column1: # Where a weapon is when it is not in the hand. node: the body node; x y z: metres in that node's frame (x to the creature's RIGHT, y forward, z up); roll pitch yaw: degrees, applied as T*Rz*Ry*Rx; a gun's barrel runs along its own +y, so roll -90 points it down and roll 90 up; a blade, a saber and a baton run along +z (roll 180 points it down, pitch 205 down and to the left). scale: the weapon's size when stored (a double blade is 2.3 m). shape: the plain holster drawn there (its long side along y). Tuned from frames.
